title: While your home awaits a decision
meaning: Closeness helps you keep home warm, but should not alone replace comforts that have been left waiting too long for a decision.
text: Care can stay alive in your shared home even among unfinished tasks. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara notices simple possibilities: preparing something good, putting out flowers or making room beside each other. The Hanged Man in energy tests your footing through a prolonged standstill. A necessary change is still being considered from different angles without becoming an action. The Lovers in emotions find peace in your closeness. With someone dear beside you, inconvenience is easier to bear, although everyday life does not necessarily become more spacious.

For example, you have wanted to replace uncomfortable chairs for a long time but cannot agree on suitable ones. Each evening you add cushions, cook a good dinner and joke about the temporary arrangement. **Love supports a home that still needs comfortable chairs.** Warmth makes the wait easier without deciding the purchase. You can be sincerely glad of each other while recognising that your familiar workaround now asks too much of an ordinary evening.

The difficulty is hearing a request for change as doubt about your closeness. Inconvenience becomes evidence that love can bear a little more. Outwardly, peace survives while the decision recedes. Support becomes more tangible when your connection allows a need to be named directly, without testing affection or first surrendering the wish for a more comfortable shared life.
